shape_cases.name: no_tagged_structure_pdfa_1b
shape_cases.rationale: A valid PDF/A-1b document has no logical structure tree; the PDF/A-1a tagging predicates are inapplicable under the PDF/A-1b profile.

mutation_cases.rationale: The canonical metadata conformance value is changed from A to B and only the PDF/A-1a conformance-value predicate may be added.
Only catalog MarkInfo is removed from the canonical tagged document.
Only the catalog StructTreeRoot entry is removed from the canonical tagged document.
Only the canonical structure tree RoleMap type is changed to an invalid scalar.
Only the canonical acyclic RoleMap is replaced with a two-node cycle.
Only the catalog language value is removed from the canonical structured document.
Only one rendered Type0 font ToUnicode entry is removed from the canonical document.

applicability_cases.name: no_annotations
applicability_cases.rationale: The canonical baseline contains no page annotations, so the annotation subtype predicate is explicitly inapplicable.

applicability_cases.name: no_forms
applicability_cases.rationale: The canonical baseline has no AcroForm, so the NeedAppearances predicate is explicitly inapplicable.

applicability_cases.name: no_embedded_files
applicability_cases.rationale: The canonical baseline has no file specification or embedded-file tree.

applicability_cases.name: no_optional_content
applicability_cases.rationale: The canonical baseline has no optional-content properties or groups.

applicability_cases.name: no_lzw_stream
applicability_cases.rationale: The canonical baseline contains no LZW-filtered stream, making the LZW prohibition predicate inapplicable.

applicability_cases.name: no_inline_image
applicability_cases.rationale: The canonical baseline has no inline image resource, so the inline-image LZW predicate has no applicable population.

applicability_cases.name: no_type3_fonts
applicability_cases.rationale: The canonical baseline uses an embedded TrueType font and contains no Type 3 font, so the Type 3 glyph-presence population is empty.

applicability_cases.name: unsupported_unused_font_subtype
applicability_cases.rationale: The fixture declares an unused font resource with an unsupported subtype; because no page content uses it, neither validator creates an applicable font-subtype failure.

cases.name: accepted_a
cases.rationale: An explicit PDF/A-1a declaration satisfies the A conformance identifier predicate.

cases.name: baseline_b
cases.rationale: A PDF/A-1b declaration fails the PDF/A-1a conformance identifier predicate.

cases.name: missing_conformance
cases.rationale: A declaration without conformance fails the PDF/A-1a conformance identifier predicate.

cases.name: missing_identification
cases.rationale: Without PDF/A identification metadata, this conformance-value predicate is inapplicable; the identification rule is covered separately.

upstream_failure_cases.name: struct_tree_cyclic
upstream_failure_cases.rationale: The recursive StructTreeRoot/P/K graph is bounded locally; veraPDF 1.30.2 aborts while traversing this upstream repro.

upstream_mismatch_cases.name: unicode_type0_identity_h
upstream_mismatch_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 reports a failure for Identity-H, so the local implementation follows the pinned reference behavior despite the profile text's exception wording.
